content: I found this session with Martin really useful. He is clear, entertaining, open to discussions and ideas. He's a good listener and communicator. I really appreciated the interactive approach of the session which makes you feel always engaged, motivated and considered. Martin built the session around the participants, their roles, experiences and responses. He provided us with a lot of material to think about and gave us key elements to trigger new useful mechanisms in order to operate most effectively in our job. The session was not only standard information and concepts but it guided us towards new awareness and new approaches that can help us in our daily work situations and relationships. Martin presented us with hypothetical work situations and asked us to try and think how to better cope with them. Attitudes , individual barriers, strong and week points are some of the different aspects we've been trough during the whole process but I like that everything seemed to come naturally and that's obviously thanks to the great work Martin has done. Interesting points to me are: working on benefits and drawbacks while trying to lead people towards solutions or procedures or simply when we want to get answers; words, music(rhythm) and dance (body language) are all important in communication; neutral positioning (an opinion can be attached to us); the 5:45:10 style model; to mirror and to adapt are key aspects; change the emphasis from problems to solutions.

Martin (the trainer) was an extremely professional and experienced coach who provided practical solutions. Definitely recommended!

(Thanks a ton, Martin!)

author: Salman Elahi

author: Hannah Tucker

author: Alice Cutler

title: Learning How to Work Effectively

author: Beth Eyre

title: Thanks Martin :)
content: You're the best!
author: Sarah

title: Excellent session

Thank you, Martin.

I found all of the concepts extremely valuable and I know that our organization will benefit from the application of this training. Other areas in our organization will be participating in this training in the future. I would highly recommend.

title: Very engaging

A good level of interaction, enjoyed the breakout rooms - maybe we could add polls and have a video call section. 
Would be good for scripts to be made available in advance/in breakout rooms so we do not have to memorise them.
author: Katharine Wadia

title: Clifford Chance PSC - Working Effectively at Clifford Chance (with Martin Chapman)
content:
Martin delivered the session very well and is a very enthusiastic speaker. He did well to keep everyone engaged (with a topic which, on the face of it, is not overly exciting to trainees!).  

The session was good and got us thinking critically about methods of day-to-day working which we usually take for granted/do subconsciously, which in some cases are bad habit. Martin had an appreciation that in the working context (heat of the moment) things are not as easy as talking them through, but gave us practical pointers that we can build upon and practice as juniors.
author: Lewis W

title: Great session
content: Informative and interactive - well enjoyed, thank you Martin!
author: Lewis

title: My take-away
content: Was really interesting to discover some practical tips on how to be more assertive in a professional context and how to interact with more senior members of the firm. More time for self-reflection would have been good.
author: Beth Eyre

title: A really insightful and enjoyable session
content: Thank you to Martin for running a great session on Professional Business Communication. There was exactly the right amount of interaction and participation, and I learnt a lot. The whole session was well organised and executed, and I left the session with ideas for the future and wisdom on different communication methods.
author: Chantal

title: Working Effectively at Firm
content: Martin was a wonderful trainer, who maintained our engagement and participation despite the potential limitations of an online session. The mix of spoken and written answers, break out room discussions and role playing activities meant that the hours flew by, and I have gained important skills that will put me in good stead for this early stage in my career.
author: Boma George

title: An interactive and informative virtual session
content: Martin definitely made the most of the current working conditions and delivered an engaging session, full of actionable points.
author: Tommy

title: Excellent virtual presentation training
content: Martin  exceeded our expectations tailoring a virtual presentation skills workshop to our needs and giving us many tips on how to improve our presenting skills and slides. Great value guaranteed.
author: Rosalind

title: Plenty of time and space to ask questions
content: Martin covers the material very clearly, with lots of interaction. He also allows plenty of time and space to ask questions which may be personal to you and your experiences and his answers are thoughtful and helpful. It results in a tailored and useful session that can easily be applied in the working environment.
author: Eleanor Hervey-Bathurst

title: Excellent virtual event training
content: Martin Chapman delivered an engaging and thought provoking training to help us improve our virtual event presentations. Tailoring his training to our needs, he exceeded our expectations and we feel more confident and brimming with ideas on how to move forward.
author: Rosalind Hunter

title: Interesting and engaging
content: I attended the Professional Business Communication training with Martin Chapman. I found the training to be very interesting, and directly relevant to my current role. I found that I learnt skills which I could directly apply to my work, and which would help me immediately. The course was 3.5 hours but it was very engaging, meaning that it held my attention for the whole duration. Thank you!
author: Chloe Lettington

title: Martin was great
content: Martin was a great trainer - he was engaging and relatable, offering very useful advice and strategies.
author: Maryam Khalifa

title: Professional Business Communication
content: Martin was very interactive and made sure that everyone was involved despite the barriers that virtual sessions present. He also related to real life examples 'e.g. in a partner training session they said x,y,z' which was nice to hear that trainee training is also being replicated on a partner level. It was a long session, but I was not time watching and felt engaged with each section, which is a great achievement for Martin.
author: Emma Buchanan

title: Very illuminating
content: Learning how important it is not only to hone one's communication skills, but also how to tailor these to others' personalities was illuminating and useful.
author: Oliver James

title: Really interesting and engaging
content: A very helpful virtual presentation from Martin with lots of interaction and personalised feedback - provides lots of ideas, tips and guidance, thanks!

I also enjoyed the interaction with the speaker, meaning that I was not just a listener but I got to take part as well. It was also a great demonstration of how speed and intonation are crucial for delivering a speech. Thank you again.
author: Martin Urban

content:
The workshop with Martin was interesting and well organized. He quickly created an atmosphere of sharing and learning and was himself an example of how to present virtually with impact. 
At times the presentation did spend a bit too much time on sharing thoughts and experiences and could have gone deeper and quicker. Overall I would recommend attending and recommend Martin's presentation skills.
author: Arthur

title: Brilliant and insightful training
content: Martin's webinar training was incredibly thorough and useful. It covered all bases and we will be applying all that we learnt to our own webinars in the future.
author: Sarah L

title: Some great tips for presenting on line
content: Martin was well organised. He had an informative and helpful manner. It was useful how he reviewed our slides and made some suggestions as to how they could be improved -  that was very useful. The session was well paced and well delivered with good client participation. Martin clearly has a passion for presenting and this extended to him offering further support after the session, which is a sign of his commitment to help.  I would have liked to see some recognition / advice about how to try and make  slides more inclusive in terms of people with visual impairments / learning needs ie in terms of font / colour /contrast as if not considered the presentation can be very excluding. Thankyou Martin it was very helpful and a pleasure to partake in.
author: Maria Martin

title: Practical and useful!

title: Very usefull

Would highly recommend this service to anyone looking to improve their online presence and virtual presenting skills.

You can achieve so much and turn even difficult communication into communication that is satisfying for all sides. Martin has responded to each of us. I liked very much that he asked everyone about special situations and then analysed with us how best to behave in such situations. That was very helpful. I have recommend the course to my colleagues. After taking part in the course, I noticed that there is also a need among my colleagues.
author: Jutta Vogeley-Kyere

title: An excellent session on presenting virtually
content: Engaging presenter, who demonstrated the skills of presenting well while delivering the session, and brought attendees in through useful workshop exercises. Lots of food for thought and I came away with tips and skills that I will definitely be implementing in the future.

title: A practical, enjoyable and relevant course

title: A helpful and recommandable virtual training

title: Presentation Training

title: Efficient, helpful and entertaining training

Thanks!

title: Great session

Thank you!

Thank you for your time!

title: Interactive/Informative - Would highly recommend!
content:
I have attended two courses with Martin now: 

1. Embracing change; and 
2. Professional Business Communication 

The latter of which was a virtual training course due to the Covid-19 pandemic.  

On both occasions I have found the sessions to be very interesting and interactive.  I can be shy when speaking up in front of people but Martin is a great listener and makes you feel comfortable.  He is intuitive and is able to expand on anything  you are finding difficult to explain/understand.  

I felt that Martin was able to tailor the courses to my role as a secretary and was able to  demonstrate what we could take away from each course.  

Martin followed up on both occasions with slides from the courses and asked if we had any questions. 

I would definitely recommend these sessions!

content: Thoroughly enjoyed this training course.  Interesting and kept me intrigued throughout.
author: Allanna Williams

title: Communication workshop with Martin Chapman
content: I learned a lot from this session and was able to give my thoughts consistently throughout the day, being told that nothing was wrong and was given interesting ways to approach situations in the future.
author: Linda Smith

title: Positive
content: The course was very pro-active and the trainers had a good sense of humor, by which participants were participating. What I learned that day is of high value for me, as I try to use the approach of who a person is and what characteristics belonog to that person during work now.
author: Carlijn Tenge

title: Professional Business Communication
content: I found this training really useful and relatable to my current job role and the Business Admin apprenticeship course I am currently undertaking. Martin delivered this course extremely well and I loved the fact it was interactive so we all got a chance to participate. Nov 2018
author: Megan Neaves

title: Really interesting and informative.
content: I really enjoyed this training and it taught me a lot about myself, my work relationships and how I can improve my communication best to suit my role. Martin made us feel really as ease so I was more than happy to speak during the session and he would tailor questions/ideas to us if we felt the first time it didn't really suit our situation. I learnt a lot and would be more than happy to attend another training of yours. Thank you for coming to see us.
author: Francesca Stevens

title: Fee Negotiating Training
content: Martin designed and delivered ‘Fee Negotiating Training for Senior Fee Earners’, that is Partners and Senior Associates. The sessions were tailored to the firm’s specific needs and those of the practice areas; each workshop was delivered in collaboration with colleagues from the Finance Team in the firm. The training was very well received and we had very positive feedback from Partners and Senior Associates, with some immediate practical applications of the principles covered.
author: Darren Jesse

title: Great Nudge event
content: Martin joined Hackney’s HR, OD and Elections teams for a fantastic introduction to Nudge. I am very grateful for how Martin tailored the event for us, we learned a lot and will be implementing some Nudge techniques. Great and engaging delivery style! I highly recommend Martin if you’re looking for something similar and we look forward to working with him again.
author: Astrid Keogh, London Borough of Hackney

title: Highly engaging workshop - Personal Efficiency
content: This was truly an amazing workshop. The trainer was highly engaging and the sessions were interactive allowing all participants the chance to contribute and share their own experiences/examples. The course helped me to identify the potential causes of inefficiency as well as provide practical steps to develop action plans to develop personal efficiency. I highly recommend this training to anyone seeking to learn how to do things more efficiently and achieve long lasting results.
author: Adwoa Acquah

title: Personal Efficiency Training Programme
content: An incredibly valuable course resulting in an implementable personal action plan. The initial call and activity log provided an opportunity to reflect in advance of the classroom session and then the day long course was a much needed ‘step away’ moment and was both tailored and practical. Martin took time to focus on the group’s needs as well as each individual’s whilst taking us through the theory to better understand behavioural change. I would highly recommend this course.
author: Diane Cains, London

title: Personal Impact & Effectiveness Training
content: I found the training to be very beneficial and practical, and even more so from young professional’s point of view. I would consider the training to be with extremely great practical importance wether in everyday life or getting ahead and achieving one’s goals
author: Mirko Kikkamägi

title: Communication Training
content: Martin Chapman was great at the training. Interactive and so useful in order to know how to deal with all the lawyers in our team and clients in difficult (and daily) situations. Hope I can attend to another of his training soon. Thank you very much.
author: Alba Sande – Lawyer

title: Food for thought - Communication Skills Training
content: A thought provoking session which made me think about my perception of others and how I can alter my communication in response to different personalities.
author: Mo

title: Professional Business Communication
content: The course was interactive and provided fresh ways of dealing with situations that may crop up at work.
author: Ashleigh

title: Finance Is Fun! Finance for non Finance Training
content: Really interesting to understand the company and the industry. Berlin May 2017
author: Tiago Antonio, Gilead

title: Nudge Training - video conference session
content: Martin delivered the Nudge Training for 9 CC participants. I enjoyed the session and took away some great tips and tricks to promote and market our course emails. Thank you!
author: Esther Visser

title: Review of Leadership Training with Martin Chapman
content: I found Martin an excellent trainer. I really enjoyed and appreciated his collegiate approach rooted in discussion and the sharing of ideas. This was a refreshing take on an strategically important topic. I was definitely able to take with me some strong ideas back to the office, ideas which indeed only formed during and thus as a result of Martin’s approach.
author: David Charles

title: Martin Chapman's sessions; Leadership & Personal Efficiency
content: I have had the privilege to attend two separate sessions of Martin, and both were exceptionally interesting and valuable. I can surely recommend attending a training with him.
author: Marcel van Wijk, Netherlands

title: Communiaction Training
content: Excellent training with lots of take aways for the daily work and communication challenges. Small group and realistic training exercises, very interactive.
author: Carolin

title: Communication Skills Training
content: I found the Communication Skills Training a very useful tool to make my day-to-day work in my team even more effective. The workshops were really interesting and based on wide experience of the lecturer.
author: Monika Koziel

title: Communication Skills Training
content: Very interesting training session with lots of useful tips and the participants all gave good feedback.
author: Simran Thawani, Baker McKenzie.
